abilities.name: Meow-teor Kick

_curatorNotes: Shield of Safe Transport authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10 (sidecar 'Shield DMG Absorption' 10th column '18.0% Max HP+2117'; gcsim shield.go shieldHP() = shieldPP[talent]*MaxHP + shieldFlat[talent], shieldPP[9]=0.18, shieldFlat[9]=2117.0693). generateSkillShield fires in all three cast forms (skillPress/skillShortHold/skillHold) — one effect on the base ability covers press and hold since the Hold shield is identical to the Press shield (kit text: 'a Shield of Safe Transport identical to the one that can be created by pressing the skill').
Target 'active': gcsim genShield adds to Player.Shields with Target -1 (standard party shield on the active character; persists across swaps).

durationType 'refresh': on recast the remaining absorption stacks onto the new shield and the 12s duration resets (gcsim genShield: shieldamt += existingShield.CurrentHP(); Expires = c.Core.F + 12*60). The stacked total is capped at 'Max Shield DMG Absorption' (28.8% Max HP + 3391 @TL10; gcsim maxShieldHP() with maxShieldPP[9]=0.288, maxShieldFlat[9]=3390.632) — schema shield Effect has no cap field, so the stacked-shield ceiling is not modelled.
Shield absorbs Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness — not modelled (no per-element shield-efficiency primitive).

abilities.description:
Press
Leaps into the air with all the agility of a cat passing through the bushes, and thwacks her foes with a flying kick that deals AoE Dendro DMG while creating a Shield of Safe Transport. This will also briefly apply Dendro to Kirara. The shield will absorb Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness. The shield's DMG absorption will be based on Kirara's Max HP and will not exceed a certain percentage of that Max HP. The remaining DMG absorption on a Shield of Safe Transport will stack on a new one when it is created, and its duration will reset.

Hold
Out of her desire to "deliver within half a day," Kirara deploys a Shield of Safe Transport identical to the one that can be created by pressing the skill. She will also curl up into a special express delivery box, entering the Urgent Neko Parcel state in order to move and fight more swiftly.

Urgent Neko Parcel
· Deals Dendro DMG to opponents she crashes into. This effect can be triggered once on each opponent every 0.5s.
· When in this state, Kirara's movement speed, climbing speed, and jumping power are all increased, and her Stamina Consumption from climbing is increased.
· When the duration ends or the skill is used again, a Flipclaw Strike more powerful than the attack in the Press Mode will be unleashed, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.
· The Urgent Neko Parcel state lasts a maximum of 10s. When the state ends, the skill will enter CD. The longer Kirara spends in this state, the longer the CD will be.
· Sprinting or actively canceling climbing will end this state early.
_curatorNotes: Shield of Safe Transport authored on effects[] (HP-scaled: 18.0% Max HP + 2117 @TL10, 12s fixed duration, target 'active', refresh semantics). Value provenance and the un-modelled stacking cap live in that effect's _curatorNotes.
Shield absorbs Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness — not modeled (schema has no element-specific shield-effectiveness field).
Skill self-applies dendro for 6 frames on cast (gcsim: `player.ApplySelfInfusion(attributes.Dendro, 25, 0.1*60)`). Not authored — the planner has no self-aura model.

abilities.name: Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch
abilities.description: Smash opponents with a Special Delivery Package used for punishing parcel thieves, dealing AoE Dendro DMG. After the Special Delivery Package explodes, it will split up into many Cat Grass Cardamoms that will explode either upon contact with opponents or after a period of time, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.
_curatorNotes: Initial Special Delivery Package hit lands at frame 38 (gcsim: `boxHitmark = 38`); cardamoms spawn at the same frame. Default cardamom count = 6 (gcsim: `c.cardamoms = 6`).

Cardamoms either explode on contact with enemies or expire after 12s, at which point any remaining are released sequentially with 18-frame stagger. Schema's stationary `summons[]` represents the lifetime; per-cardamom contact-trigger semantics aren't modeled.

C1 adds up to 4 extra cardamoms (1 per 8000 Max HP) — a scaling buff on the summon's projectile count, not a damage scaling on existing hits. Flagged on the C1 constellation entry; not modeled on the burst summon.

passives.name: Bewitching, Betwitching Tails
passives.description: When Kirara is in the Urgent Neko Parcel state of Meow-teor Kick, each impact against an opponent will grant her a stack of Reinforced Packaging. This effect can be triggered once for each opponent hit every 0.5s. Max 3 stacks. When the Urgent Neko Parcel state ends, each stack of Reinforced Packaging will create 1 Shield of Safe Transport for Kirara. The shields that are created this way will have 20% of the DMG absorption that the Shield of Safe Transport produced by Meow-teor Kick would have. If Kirara is already protected by a Shield of Safe Transport created by Meow-teor Kick, its DMG absorption will stack with these shields and its duration will reset.
_curatorNotes: No effects authored. This is a stack-gated shield-stacking mechanic on box-mode exit (gcsim: `a1Stacks` counter, max 3, +1 per enemy hit every 0.5s; `a1()` at exit creates `0.2 * shieldHP * stacks` shield). Schema has no 'stacks accumulated during state, consumed on state-exit, scale a shield' representation. Reviewer to model.

passives.name: Pupillary Variance
passives.description: Every 1,000 Max HP Kirara possesses will increase the DMG dealt by Meow-teor Kick by 0.4%, and the DMG dealt by Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch by 0.3%.
_curatorNotes: Scaling buff (HP-scaled DMG bonus on E and Q). Per recipe — not authored. gcsim: skill bonus = `MaxHP * 0.001 * 0.004` as DmgP modifier on AttackTagElementalArt and AttackTagElementalArtHold; burst bonus = `MaxHP * 0.001 * 0.003` on AttackTagElementalBurst. Reviewer to decide scaling-buff representation.

constellations.name: Material Circulation
constellations.description: Every 8,000 Max HP Kirara possesses will cause her to create 1 extra Cat Grass Cardamom when she uses Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch. A maximum of 4 extra can be created this way.
_curatorNotes: Scaling effect on cardamom count (Q summon projectile count, +1 per 8000 MaxHP, capped at +4). Not authored — schema has no 'scaling projectile count on a summon' representation. gcsim: `bonus := min(int(c.MaxHP()/8000), 4); c.cardamoms += bonus`. Reviewer to model.

constellations.name: Perfectly Packaged
constellations.description:
When Kirara is in the Urgent Neko Parcel state of Meow-teor Kick, she will grant other party members she crashes into Critical Transport Shields.
The DMG absorption of Critical Transport Shield is 40% of the maximum absorption Meow-teor Kick's normal Shields of Safe Transport are capable of, and will absorb Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness.
Critical Transport Shields last 12s and can be triggered once on each character every 10s.
_curatorNotes: Co-op only — not implemented in gcsim (cons.go: `// C2 is not implemented, co-op only`). Reviewer to confirm in-game whether C2 grants any single-player benefit; if not, leave unmodeled.

constellations.name: Steed of Skanda
constellations.description: After active character(s) protected by Shields of Safe Transport or Critical Transport Shields hit opponents with Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, Kirara will perform a coordinated attack with them using Small Cat Grass Cardamoms, dealing 200% of her ATK as Dendro DMG. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 3.8s. This CD is shared between all party members.
_curatorNotes: Inherited `manual` trigger. Likely `onHit` with `abilityType` matching N/C/plunge from any active char while Shield of Safe Transport (or Critical Transport Shield) is up on caster, with a 3.8s shared procCooldown. gcsim: subscribes to OnEnemyDamage, gates on existing Shields.KiraraSkill + AttackTag in {Normal, Extra, Plunge}, then fires a coordinated dendro attack tagged AttackTagElementalBurst with `Mult: 2`. ICD `c4IcdStatus = 3.8*60`. Scaling 200 / stat atk / element dendro / target enemy are correct; trigger type is the only field needing reviewer rewrite.

constellations.name: Countless Sights to See
constellations.description: All nearby party members gain a 12% All Elemental DMG Bonus for 15s after Kirara uses her Elemental Skill or Burst.
_curatorNotes: Inherited `manual` trigger. Likely two `onCast` triggers — one with `ability: 'skill'`, one with `ability: 'burst'`. gcsim: `c6()` runs in both `skillPress`/`skillShortHold`/`skillHold` and `Burst` branches, gated on Cons >= 6, applying a 15s StatMod to every party member.

Stat modeling note: gcsim assigns the +12% to each of PyroP/HydroP/CryoP/ElectroP/AnemoP/GeoP/PhyP/DendroP individually (8 separate stat keys), not to a single 'allDmgBonus' aggregate. The current `stat: 'allDmgBonus'` may or may not match this codebase's allDmgBonus semantics. Reviewer to verify whether allDmgBonus aggregates over per-element + physical or only over the elemental subset.
Target 'team' is correct — gcsim loops over all party members including Kirara herself.
